correctness.summary: Schubert bridge additivity and the universal stick>=2b+2 lower bound match Sato's external-edge connected-sum upper bound exactly for two bridge-bound-saturating knots. Trefoils provide a six-stick external-edge factor at every iteration, and the nineteen cited base knots are verified 10-stick, 4-bridge knots.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Classical composition, external-edge, bridge-additivity, and bridge/superbridge results were separated from the new matching criterion. No located source states the criterion or its application to the nineteen 2025/2026 exact 10-stick primes; residual folklore risk remains because the proof is a short synthesis.

value.summary: The criterion turns a geometric upper construction into an exact formula and converts nineteen recently isolated exact prime values into nineteen infinite families of exact composite stick numbers.

limitations: The base knot must satisfy stick(K)=2b(K)+2.
The general two-factor criterion needs a minimum-stick external-edge representative of one factor.
No external-edge claim is made for the nineteen base knots themselves.
Only ordinary stick number is treated.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; an equivalent folklore corollary under polygon-index terminology may exist.
